intro.en: Custom Micro-D cable assemblies for compact aerospace, defense, instrumentation, medical and industrial electronics, with defined interface, circuit map, cable construction, retention, shielding and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向紧凑型航空航天、国防、仪器、医疗及工业电子设备定制 Micro-D 电缆组件，明确接口、回路图、线缆结构、锁紧、屏蔽与检验要求。

knowledge.en: Micro-D identifies a miniature connector family, not a complete cable or qualification statement.
knowledge.zh: Micro-D 标识微型连接器家族，并不等于完整电缆规范或资质声明。

notes.en: Provide exact mating references, contact arrangement, wiring view, cable construction, hardware, route and acceptance requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确对插料号、触点排列、接线视图、线缆结构、锁紧件、路径及验收要求。

delivery.en: Approve the interface schedule, termination sample, mechanical configuration and electrical inspection evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认接口清单、端接样品、机械配置与电气检验证据。

subtitle.zh: 高密度微型互连，也要完整定义

lead.en: Define the complete mechanical, electrical and documentation system before production.
lead.zh: 生产前定义完整的机械、电气与文件体系。
